title: WRRA M High-Energy-to-Phenotype Extension 1.0: Thermal Probes, Record Stability, Component Activation, Harmonic States and Downstream Reconnection
description: Reviewed consolidation of stages 0.1-0.12 extending the frozen WRRA M integrated baseline upstream toward high-energy thermal probes, the micro/macro record-stability boundary, origin-preserving component activation, primitive-alphabet minimality, neutrino harmonic bookkeeping, and nonduplicated reconnection to phenotype energy, pressure, gravity and homogeneous expansion. Structural closure passes; autonomous temperature-to-generation laws, primitive-to-particle Hamiltonian generation, upstream PMNS derivation, and one common fully covariant SI background-plus-nonuniform evolution remain explicit open interfaces. The release does not identify the WRRA frame with Planck time and does not claim exactly four primitive types.
notes: Published as a single Zenodo record covering stages 0.1-0.12. Preserve cited source-release authorship and provenance.
